notes: Rejected 2026-11-17 on his word: it stands on legs, and "wheels are mandatory". Until then the step-up: no drawers, and its 49 5/8" leaves 1 3/8" on a wall whose kitchen face is untaped. The pick is Yaheetech's 46 x 22" island (amazon-B0C8N5JH8H). Andrew, 2026-11-17: "I want a floating kitchen island. Place on the wall opposite side of wall of where the living room console is (in the kitchen is where I will put it)." Slot: the kitchen face of the 51" wall whose living-room face holds the Decofy console (F-20); taken as the same 51" on the kitchen side, untaped. The kitchen is not measured, so the walkway in front of the piece (F-30: 30" at least, 36" preferred; 42" where it faces the range, sink or fridge, the designer's standard) is unchecked until Andrew tapes from that wall to whatever faces it. Fit: 49 5/8" leaves 1 3/8" of the 51", so only if the kitchen face really has all 51"; 30 3/8" deep, so the kitchen needs 66 3/8" clear from that wall for a 36" walkway and 72 3/8" for a 42" work aisle, untaped. A free-standing island on legs, no wheels: "Free-standing kitchen island; easy to place where you want it in the kitchen"; "Countertop with a thick oak veneer ... can be sanded and surface treated"; two open shelves in its photos. Best seller; 4.7 stars (841); in stock in IKEA Long Island, NY; home delivery to 11365 from $19.00; "Return within 365 days for a full refund*"; IKEA assembly $92.30. A 28 3/8x20 1/2" size is $359.99 on the same page, not opened. Kept as the step-up for after the kitchen is taped; at $449.99 it is three times the carts. Flags: none from the vocabulary; the walkway is unchecked. rooms: the brief.
